incident.observed: After successful doctor and project:create:context, the host emitted message.complete followed by running:false. There was no project:create, execution resolution, preparation, task binding or delivery. The controller subsequently closed an idle session; it did not interrupt active work.
incident.promptDefect: The CLI handoff and authoring guide required a separate assistant report but did not distinguish interim progress from a final text response or explicitly require same-turn tool execution after reporting.
incident.causalLimit: Native events prove premature completion at the report boundary. A single model run does not establish a unique model-internal cause. Local Hermes source confirms that assistant text with tool calls can be emitted as interim progress, while a final text response exits the conversation loop.

fix.runtime: Create-context, create-success and inspect handoffs explicitly continue authorized tool execution after progress reporting; create-success still stops on a render mismatch.
fix.guides: Repository and generated Workspace skills distinguish progress reports from final answers, specify Hermes text plus the next tool call, and preserve blockers, explicit user pauses and native pending-work yields.
fix.authority: Diagnostic text only. No new production state, approval, retry, completion authority or validator relaxation.

verification.red: Create-context and inspect tests fail on missing interim-progress semantics; scaffold test fails on missing generated Workspace guidance.
